description: Registry of available template plugins. Templates are now organized in plugin directories with clear type taxonomy.
type_taxonomy_documentation: See TYPE_TAXONOMY.md for details on template_type, repository_type, and category

templates.notes: Planner template with document upload: template_type=sql_query → repository_type=planner
Knowledge Graph template: template_type=knowledge_graph → populates GraphStore (SQLite), not ChromaDB
Declarative KG template: template_type=knowledge_graph, discovery_mode=industry_model → deterministic walk of a Databricks model.json into GraphStore (no LLM/MCP)

Declarative KG template: template_type=knowledge_graph, discovery_mode=andp_semantic -> reads a DEPLOYED AI-Native Data Product's own semantic module (plus Memory/Observability) and walks it into the two-layer topology. Deterministic, zero-token, re-syncable.

Declarative KG template: template_type=knowledge_graph, discovery_mode=declared_model -> walks an ISO/IEC 11179 metadata registry stored WITH a model on Teradata (object_class/data_element/value_domain/permissible_value/association) into the two-layer topology. Deterministic, zero-token, re-syncable.

template_status_definitions.beta: Template is available but still being tested
template_status_definitions.coming_soon: Template is under development and will be available soon

template_type.description: Strategy/execution type - defines HOW the template processes data

repository_type.description: Storage model - defines HOW collection data is stored in database

category.description: UI grouping - organizes templates in user interface
